# quota-pacer v1.0.17

## 更新内容

### 中文

- **修复与支持 Codex 商业版订阅配额解析**（PR #9）：
  - 过去 Codex 的方案推导（`inferPlanType`）仅识别 `plus`、`pro` 与 `team`。当凭据属于 ChatGPT Business 或 Self-Serve Business（API 返回 `business` 或 `self_serve_business_prolite`）时，会被降级为 `core.PlanTypeUnknown`，导致周配额解析受阻。
  - 本次更新将其正确映射至付费 Team 方案（`core.PlanTypeTeam`），确保商业版凭据的周度可用配额与重置时间能被精准探测并纳入配速规划。
- **文档与测试套件术语全面统一**（PR #8 & 99476ac）：
  - 在 v1.0.16 引入全局平移（Global Uplift）机制后，测试用例与注释中仍残留有废弃的 `remainingHeadroom` 函数调用及单凭据超速截断为 0 的旧逻辑描述。
  - 全面清理并统一测试用例与文档规范，明确区分原始配速富余度（raw headroom）、全局平移（global uplift）与归一化配速富余度（normalized headroom），确保代码与算法设计严格一致。

### English

- **Fix & Support Codex Business Subscription Quota Plans** (PR #9):
  - Previously, Codex plan inference (`inferPlanType`) only handled `plus`, `pro`, and `team`. Credentials on ChatGPT Business or Self-Serve Business plans (returning `business` or `self_serve_business_prolite`) fell back to `core.PlanTypeUnknown`, preventing proper weekly quota evaluation.
  - These plans are now recognized and mapped to the paid Team tier (`core.PlanTypeTeam`), ensuring weekly remaining quotas and reset windows for business credentials are correctly parsed and scheduled.
- **Documentation and Test Terminology Alignment** (PR #8 & 99476ac):
  - Following the global headroom uplift refactor in v1.0.16, test cases and comments still contained references to the retired `remainingHeadroom` function and obsolete floor-to-zero assumptions.
  - Updated tests and comments across the board to consistently use the raw / uplift / normalized headroom terminology, aligning documentation directly with current algorithm design.
